verdict.rationale: Expensify documents its own spend controls: "Smart Limits on cards" and the ability to approve or reject expenses and build workspace rules. Nothing in the evidence shows budgets allocated to teams or projects, or limits and approvals tied to those budgets. Missing for 10: team/project budget allocation, enforcement of limits and approvals against allocated budgets, detailed docs on how Smart Limits work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
